facts.statement: Community events are held every Thursday by the Community Team at a different location.
facts.quote: Cada jueves el Equipo Comunitario se congrega en un lugar diferente para festejar.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Inicio al 2011 (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice announcing the first community party of 2011, held weekly on Thursdays at a different location, with the Snow Hill stage on Server 1 as the venue. It gives two session times: one for US and Latin America and one for UK and Europe, both on Server 1. The page's 'posted 4 months, 4 weeks ago' label conflicts with the January 2011 event dates, so the posting date is uncertain.
